name: epic-loop
description: Run large, multi-phase epics as long-running autonomous jobs, driven by Codex or Claude Code hooks and durable on-disk state.

interface.longDescription: Run large, multi-phase epics as long-running autonomous jobs that hold their intent across context rot and goal drift. The loop rotates between a techlead (writes a per-task brief for the engineer) and an engineer (focused on executing that one brief), driven by project-local Codex or Claude Code hooks and durable on-disk state.
defaultPrompt: Use epic-loop to shape and run this epic.
